text:
Zoe Park: Quick kudos thread  shoutout to @Theo and FacilitiesTeam for organizing the surprise snack drop for the late-deploy crew last night  best morale boost ever :sparkles:
Theo Martin: Team effort! Lina helped pick GF snacks and Aiden ran the midnight delivery. special mention to Facilities for the eco napkins. :recycle:
Lina Gomez: Loved that people left little thank-you notes on the whiteboard. tiny things go a long way.
Aiden Brooks: Also props to the oncall rotation switch  smoother handoff than usual. stayed calm and tagged accurately.
ops-bot: Note: auto-check  deploy-2026-03-22 resulted in 0 P1s. Alert burst suppression active. :gear:
FacilitiesTeam: Happy to help! We can do a low-cost plan if teams want to make this recurring. we can include dairy-free and nut-free labels.
Zoe Park: Proposal: monthly rotating appreciation (snacks one month, team lunch the next). react :thumbsup: for monthly, :thinking_face: to alternate.
Theo Martin: :thumbsup: monthly keeps it meaningful.
Lina Gomez: :thinking_face: alternate could work to spread budget.
Aiden Brooks: Either way, sign me up for deliveries. also can we add a short list of volunteers to avoid late scramble?
Zoe Park: Good idea. I'll make a simple Google Sheet and ping this thread when it's live. final shoutout to everyone who stayed late to triage  you rock. :heart:
